cases.title: Workbook monthly values vs annual summaries
cases.question: Do the workbook's monthly values and annual summaries agree?
cases.source: Monthly Summary 2026 F3:F14 sums to 2426123; F16 "ANNUAL TOTAL" 2425123; Quarterly Summary G7 2427123

answer.question: Do the workbook's monthly values and annual summaries agree?
answer.answer: No. The workbook is internally inconsistent: several January–December monthly sums do not match the Monthly Summary annual row, and the Quarterly Summary annual row also conflicts with the Monthly Summary / Source-wise annual totals for several fields. For example, summing monthly grid supply gives 1534290 kWh, while the Monthly Summary and Source-wise annual grid figures report 1533290 kWh, a 1000 kWh difference [E1][E2][E4]. Quarterly Summary appears internally consistent with its own quarterly rows, but its annual figures differ from the Monthly Summary / Source-wise annual figures for grid, solar, total renewable, total consumption, grid cost, and savings [E3].

cases.title: Complaint resolution deadline absent from policy
cases.question: Does the quality policy specify a deadline for resolving customer complaints?
cases.source: quality_policy_nestle.pdf, all pages; no time limit for complaints is stated

answer.question: Does the quality policy specify a deadline for resolving customer complaints?
answer.answer: No. The Nestlé Food Safety and Quality Policy does not specify any deadline for resolving customer complaints. The policy includes broad commitments on food safety, compliance, product quality, end-to-end quality, and responsibility, but the extracted document notes that it “does not state quantitative targets, deadlines, or measurable performance limits” [E1].

evidence.quote: The policy does not state quantitative targets, deadlines, or measurable performance limits.

answer.answer: For FY 2024-25 (2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31), the documents support only partial electricity-consumption coverage. Prestige Estates Projects Pvt Ltd has 63000 KWH for the billing period 01-06-2024 to 01-07-2024, covering June plus 1 July 2024 as printed, with no prorating applied by the FY tool [E3][E4].
